ev.q: Sleeping Dogs is an action-adventure game set in an open world environment
Unlike most similar open-world games, Sleeping Dogs emphasizes melee combat over gunplay
running, jumping, climbing over obstacles, swimming, and driving cars, boats and motorcycles
martial arts moves, fighting, shooting and parkour abilities
the story follows Wei Shen, a Hong Kong-American police officer and martial artist
The game features the option to choose from Triad, Face and Police XPs
given to Shen by the experience system during the campaign
lauded the game's depiction of Hong Kong
found the missions generic and linear
Pinsof acclaimed the city's scale and AI
Edge called Shen an engaging protagonist and complimented the other characters
